attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ymgI`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 1% of calls. The model names 96% of them, at 0.32 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns run to the window's end**, carried by 40 to 89%, 64 persistent and 15 shell, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 89% of calls. A branch of 10 families runs through columns 1 to 10, a parallel path in 10 to 11%. The `potA` to `potD` genes, columns 25 to 28, are [[spermidine/putrescine transport]].

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 90%, and hesitates less there, 0.32 against 0.50 bits. It hesitates most at column 3, `ymgF`, a fork column, 1.70 bits.

**The window ends in the `flgL` to `flgM` genes**, columns 67 to 79, [[flagellar basal body]]. The last column is `flgM`, in 40% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 90% of genes**, 0.50 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.25 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 76% against 97%.

label: ymgI
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ymgI window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ymgI, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,528 to 2,607 from dnaA. Read in 522 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ymgI once); 41,760 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.50 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 27,265 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; shell 13,930 calls, named 78%, 1.09 bits; cloud 565 calls, named 19%, 3.86 bits. Outside an RGP 28,249 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 13,511 calls, named 76%, 1.25 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 70 fork, 9 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.25 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (76% against 97%); 13,511 of the 41,760 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 (ymgF, a fork column) 1.70 bits, RGP 89%; column 13 ("protein YmgK", a fork column) 1.00 bits, RGP 80%; column 4 (pdeG, a fork column) 0.94 bits, RGP 89%. The 13 columns (columns 2-14) where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.77 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 90%, 0.45 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 96%, 0.32 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 90%, 0.50 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 3, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 1%. Genes: ymgI "protein YmgI". named 96%; 0.32 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 40-89%, 64 P, 15 S, RGP 1-89%. named 60-98% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3, named 60%, 1.70 bits.
